purpose: Phase-8A cell-state-associated resistance: a LIMITED phenotype abstraction only. States are abstract resistance-associated phenotypes - NOT a cell-cycle engine, NOT a cancer-stem-cell engine, NOT full epithelial-mesenchymal-transition biology. Stem-like / mesenchymal-like / slow-cycling labels are permitted only as abstractions and only when required by direct evidence. Schematic ordinal only.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: phenotype_tolerance in [0,1] (additive, bounded contribution to tolerance/survivor enrichment)
coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic phenotype-derived tolerance the model represents
coefficient_policy.source: general slow-cycling / persister phenotype biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: phenotype_tolerance biases survivor enrichment toward the tolerant subpopulation; it does not create a mechanism by itself.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No cell-cycle phase, stemness marker, or EMT marker is modelled (all NOT_REPORTED).
